description: This file defines internal sealed classes 'WellKnownCodecDescription' and 'WellKnownCopierDescription' within the Orleans.CodeGenerator namespace, representing descriptions for codecs and copiers with associated type symbols.

classes.name: WellKnownCodecDescription
classes.description: Represents a description of a well-known codec, holding references to underlying type and codec type symbols.

classes.name: WellKnownCopierDescription
classes.description: Represents a description of a well-known copier, holding references to underlying type and copier type symbols.

methods.name: WellKnownCodecDescription
methods.description: Constructor initializing the underlying type and codec type symbols.

methods.name: WellKnownCopierDescription
methods.description: Constructor initializing the underlying type and copier type symbols.
